summary: A pharmacist adds one medicine while chatting with a colleague. Traps: cost price is first read from an old invoice as three ninety and corrected to four ten; expiry is spoken as September twenty twenty seven, so ground truth is the last day of that month; the colleague mentions Itin twelve and Teczine arriving, which must not leak into this item.

turns.speaker: pharmacist
turns.text: Ravi, pass me that new carton, the Sun Pharma one. Let me enter it before the evening rush.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: This one? Sebifin. There is one more box of Itin twelve also, and the Teczine came.

turns.speaker: pharmacist
turns.text: Those we will do after lunch. First this. Okay, new item. Medicine, Sebifin two fifty. Generic is terbinafine, terbinafine hydrochloride, two hundred fifty milligram tablets. Manufacturer Sun Pharmaceutical.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Doctor is prescribing this a lot now, for the ringworm patients.

turns.speaker: pharmacist
turns.text: Haan, fungal season. And that uncle from yesterday came back, asking why the cream is not working. He was applying it once in three days. I told him, read the doctor's slip properly.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Every day one such uncle. Okay, what next?

turns.speaker: pharmacist
turns.text: Next, unit is strips, strip of fifteen tablets. So pack size fifteen, tablets.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Batch number is on the side. S B F zero four two one.

turns.speaker: pharmacist
turns.text: S B F zero four two one. Expiry?

turns.speaker: pharmacist
turns.text: Expiry September twenty twenty seven. MRP is five hundred thirty rupees per strip. Cost price three ninety.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Wait, wait. That is the old rate. Check the new invoice, they increased it last month.

turns.speaker: pharmacist
turns.text: Achha, you are right. Cost price four ten, not three ninety. Four hundred ten. Selling price we keep four ninety.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Four ninety, okay. GST same twelve percent?

turns.speaker: pharmacist
turns.text: Yes, GST twelve percent. Prescription required, yes, it is schedule H. Store below thirty degrees, away from direct light. Reorder level ten strips. Keep it in rack B three, the antifungal shelf.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Rack B three. Shall I go for lunch now? My wife packed biryani, the smell is killing me.

turns.speaker: pharmacist
turns.text: Go, go. Save me one piece. I'll finish the Itin after you come back.
